title: Asase 1.0.3
release_notes:
• Flet 1.1.2: ~3x smaller web bundles, 2-3x faster startup (gzip + Pyodide .pyc)
• Responsive layouts use min/max sizing (no one-frame width lag)
• Pull-to-refresh on home and history feeds
• Neutral theme surfaces + unified input styling
• Slimmer app: pydantic removed — feed models on stdlib dataclasses
